data.name: AC Hotel Panama City
data.address: Area Bancaria, Ricardo Arias St 14, Panama City, Panamá Province, Panama
data.description:
A 5-minute walk from a metro station, this contemporary hotel in the Financial District is 5 km from both the Metropolitan Natural Park and the Panama Canal Museum.
The streamlined rooms come with floor-to-ceiling windows, marble bathrooms and flat-screen TVs, in addition to minibars, tea and coffeemakers, and free Wi-Fi. Suites add separate living rooms, sofabeds and loft bedrooms, plus spiral staircases. Room service is available.
Parking is complimentary. Other amenities include a casual restaurant/bar, an outdoor rooftop infinity pool and a hot tub, as well as a gym and event space.
